jobs.title: SAP BRIM FICA Functional Architect
jobs.description:
**Hello All,** 




 Greetings From Tesslogs
 



  





 We are looking for an experienced
 **SAP BRIM FICA Functional Architect** 
 with strong hands\-on expertise in SAP BRIM, particularly in
 **FI\-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable), Convergent Invoicing (CI), and SAP FICO** 
 .
 



  





 Client: Infosys
 



 Experience: 10\+years
 



 Location: PAN INDIA
 



 Notice period: 15days/Immediate
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**A. SAP BRIM – FICA (Mandatory)** 




  




* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP BRIM FI\-CA (Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable).
* Configure and manage Business Partners and Contract Accounts.
* Experience in Open Item Management and account maintenance.
* Configure payment processing, payment runs, and payment lots.
* Hands\-on experience in automatic clearing and clearing rules.
* Configure and manage dunning procedures.
* Experience in returns processing and security deposits.
* Configure and manage FI\-CA mass activities and mass runs.
* Knowledge of account determination, reconciliation keys, posting areas, and document processing.
* Experience in FI\-CA integration with SAP FI\-AR and General Ledger.



  





**B. SAP BRIM – Convergent Invoicing (CI)** 




  




* Strong hands\-on experience in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing configuration and implementation.
* Configure billing and invoicing processes.
* Experience in Billable Item (BIT) generation, processing, and error handling.
* Knowledge of billing document creation, invoicing, and invoice reversal processes.
* Experience in integrating Convergent Invoicing with FI\-CA.
* Understanding of the complete billing and invoicing lifecycle.
* Ability to troubleshoot billing and invoicing discrepancies.



  





**C. SAP FICO Integration (Mandatory)** 




  




* Strong understanding of SAP FICO, particularly FI\-AR and General Ledger.
* Experience in SAP BRIM FICA integration with SAP FI.
* Knowledge of financial accounting, reconciliation, account determination, and posting configurations.
* Experience in troubleshooting financial posting and reconciliation issues.
* Understanding of financial impacts arising from BRIM billing and invoicing processes.
* Ability to validate financial postings and ensure reconciliation accuracy.



  





**D. SAP BRIM Implementation \& Production Support** 




  




* Hands\-on experience in end\-to\-end SAP BRIM implementation projects.
* Experience in SAP BRIM functional configuration, testing, deployment, and post\-go\-live activities.
* Practical experience in SAP BRIM production support engagements.
* Independently handle functional configuration and solution design.
* Manage incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA), and resolve complex functional issues.
* Translate business requirements into SAP BRIM functional solutions.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, technical teams, and integration teams.
* Experience in handling implementation and support activities independently.



  





**E. Additional SAP BRIM Skills** 




  




* Knowledge of SAP Subscription Order Management (SOM).
* Understanding of SAP Convergent Charging (CC).
* Experience with prepaid and postpaid billing scenarios.
* Integration with external tax systems and non\-SAP applications.
* Understanding of end\-to\-end Subscription\-to\-Cash processes.



  





**Mandatory Technical Skills** 




  





 SAP BRIM
 



 SAP BRIM FICA
 



 SAP Convergent Invoicing (CI)
 



 Hands\-on configuration
 



 SAP FICO
 



 FICA Configuration
 



 FI\-CA to FI Integration
 



 BRIM Implementation
 



 Practical project experience
 



 BRIM Production Support
 



 Practical project experience
 



 Billing \& Invoicing
 



 Payment Run / Mass Run
 



 Configuration experience
 



 Dunning \& Clearing Rules
 



 Configuration experience
 



 BIT Processing
 



  





**Best Regards** 




 Hrushitha S

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**


We innovate with SAP to help clients transform their retail operations and create sustainable business value. Drawing on our integrated competencies in tax, assurance, transactions, risk, and technology consulting, we help organizations navigate complex business transformations from strategy through execution.

  

Our objective is to provide clients with a unique business perspective on leveraging SAP technology to modernize utility operations, enhance customer experiences, improve operational efficiency, and enable growth. We are seeking an experienced SAP Utilities leader with deep industry knowledge and demonstrated experience delivering complex SAP S/4HANA Utilities / SAP IS\-U transformations.

  

From a solution perspective, we are seeking candidates with experience delivering SAP S/4HANA Utilities / SAP IS\-U transformations across areas such as:

  

* Customer Service and Customer Account Management
* Metering, Device Management, and Meter Data Integration
* Billing and Invoicing
* Contract Accounts Receivable and Payable (FI\-CA)
* Payments, Collections, and Dunning

You will lead cross\-functional teams through complex transformation programs, providing strategic guidance, delivery oversight, and executive stakeholder management while driving innovation and business value realization.

  

As a Senior Manager in Technology Consulting, you will help utility clients transform critical customer and Meter\-to\-Cash processes through SAP\-enabled solutions. You will lead large\-scale transformation initiatives, shape solution and delivery strategies, build and expand senior client relationships, and contribute to the growth of EY's SAP Utilities practice through sales, pursuits, account development, thought leadership, and talent development.

  

**Your key responsibilities**


In this role, you will lead complex SAP Utilities transformation programs, overseeing solution strategy, delivery quality, risk management, and client satisfaction. You will be responsible for managing engagement economics, strengthening executive client relationships, identifying new opportunities, and contributing to revenue growth across existing and prospective accounts.

  

You will also:

* Develop compelling SAP Utilities solutions and value propositions that differentiate EY in competitive pursuits and demonstrate measurable client value.
* Manage engagement economics, including budgeting, forecasting, staffing, revenue management, scope management, and overall engagement performance.
* Provide thought leadership on SAP Utilities trends, Meter\-to\-Cash transformation, SAP S/4HANA capabilities, customer experience, and emerging utility technologies.
* Foster collaboration across EY service lines, industry teams, SAP capabilities, and global delivery teams to deliver integrated business solutions.
* Develop, mentor, and coach high\-performing SAP professionals while supporting recruiting, performance management, and talent development initiatives.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**


To thrive in this role, you will need a combination of utilities industry knowledge, SAP IS\-U expertise, consulting leadership, client relationship skills, and strong commercial acumen.

  

* Demonstrate deep SAP Utilities / SAP IS\-U functional knowledge and an understanding of end\-to\-end utility customer and Meter\-to\-Cash business processes.

* Design and support invoice and bill print functionality, including customer\-facing billing outputs.
